summary: Completed testing of EduNet Student Schedule Portal (READ-ONLY). All backend API tests passed (11/11). Frontend UI tests passed - schedule page displays correctly with auto-detection of grade/section, teacher photos, break blocks, tooltip on hover, and NO edit controls.
passed_tests: GET /api/student/schedule - returns 200 for authenticated student
GET /api/student/schedule - returns schedules array with teacher info
GET /api/student/schedule - returns breaks array (Recreo, Almuerzo)
GET /api/student/schedule - returns settings object
GET /api/student/schedule - returns grade_name ('3 años')
GET /api/student/schedule - returns section_name ('ÚNICA')
GET /api/student/schedule - schedules contain profesor_nombre and profesor_foto
GET /api/student/schedule - returns 403 for admin users (role check)
GET /api/student/schedule - returns 401 for unauthenticated users
GET /api/student/schedule - schedule items have complete structure
Frontend: Student login works correctly
Frontend: Schedule page displays title 'Mi Horario de Clases'
Frontend: Header shows grade '3 años' and section 'ÚNICA' dynamically
Frontend: Classes display with teacher photo and name
Frontend: Break blocks (Recreo, Almuerzo) render as full-row colored blocks
Frontend: Tooltip appears on hover showing subject, teacher, time
Frontend: NO edit buttons visible
Frontend: NO configuration button visible
Frontend: NO context menu on right-click
Frontend: NO add/create buttons visible
Frontend: NO delete buttons visible
Frontend: Responsive - horizontal scroll works on mobile
Frontend: Responsive - sticky time column stays visible during scroll
Frontend: Sidebar shows 'Mi Horario' menu item
Frontend: Stats summary shows Total clases, Horas semanales, Días con clases, Profesores
seed_data_creation: None - used existing student data. Student 'Pepito Peres Rios' in grade '3 años', section 'ÚNICA' with 2 classes (Religión, Historia) and 2 breaks (Recreo 11:00-12:00, Almuerzo 13:00-14:00).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Student Schedule Portal fully tested. Backend endpoint: GET /api/student/schedule returns schedules, breaks, settings, grade_name, section_name. Frontend component: StudentSchedulePage with StudentCalendarGrid (mode='student'). Key features: auto-detection of student's grade/section (no filters), teacher photos in class blocks, break blocks as full-row colored rows, tooltip on hover, completely READ-ONLY (no edit controls, no context menu, no config button). Responsive with horizontal scroll and sticky time column.

student_schedule_api.security: Role check - only students can access (403 for admin/teacher)
